statements.t: SKYLINE Part B is enrolling ahead of schedule, enabling the Company to increase enrollment and provide topline induction results for three potential best-in-indication combinations, which are expected in Q3 2027

The combination portion of our SKYLINE trial is enrolling faster than expected enabling an increased enrollment target, and we plan to deliver topline data in Q3 2027 with the potential for efficacy, safety, and convenience that meaningfully surpasses today's standard of care,” said Cameron Turtle, DPhil, Chief Executive Officer of Spyre.

Additionally, the Company plans to advance a potential best-in-class anti-TL1A monotherapy agent into pivotal studies for HS in 2027.
The Company does not plan to advance SPY072 in rheumatic diseases.
The Company believes TL1A has emerged as one of the most promising targets in IBD and broader immunology indications.
• The Company is currently enrolling its SPY120, SPY130, and SPY230 combinations in Part B of the SKYLINE trial, with an expected induction read-out in 2027.
• The Company’s SPY772 combination program aims to target multiple inflammatory pathways involved in HS, pairing its novel anti-TL1A (SPY072) with SPY007, its anti-IL-17A/F.
